QuestInfo.name: Checking on Perion
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. \r\nMeet Dances with Balrog in Perion to see how things are going there.
QuestInfo.2: You meet Dances with Balrog in Perion. He says everything's fine.

0.0: We can't rest easy yet,  #h0#. There is more work to be done.
0.1: The Black Mage's resurrection is imminent. The Explorers of the Maple Alliance need to be ready.
0.2: So I want you to check with #bDances with Balrog#k in Perion and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.

yes.0: Every town must be prepared, but we have so little time...
Perion is in excellent shape, for today, at least. The warriors of Perion are perfectly prepared to sacrifice ourselves on the front lines against the Black Mage!

npc.0: I want you to check with #bDances with Balrog#k in Perion and make sure everything's in tip-top shape.
